_meta.purpose: Lens catalog: every axis a draft should reason about. Hero values live in knowledge/expert/hero_profiles/<slug>.json under "lenses". Checked by test_hero_profiles.py.

damage_delivery.question: How does the hero actually produce damage?

values.auto_attacker: most damage is basic attacks (Valla, Tychus, Raynor, Greymane)
values.ability_caster: most damage is abilities, autos are filler (Li-Ming, Jaina, Kael'thas)
values.hybrid: autos and abilities both carry the damage (Sylvanas, Cassia, Falstad)
values.summoner: pets, turrets or minions do the work (Azmodan, Zagara, Probius, Kel'Thuzad, Gazlowe)
values.zone_trap: damage comes from areas and traps the enemy walks into (Junkrat, Abathur nests)
values.melee_brawler: close range autos and abilities in a fight (Illidan, Sonya, Zeratul)
values.channel: damage is a channelled or charged ability that is easy to interrupt
values.utility_minimal: its damage is not why it is picked

damage_delivery.draft_use: Tells whether a comp has the right MIX of damage sources and what interrupts it.

damage_timing.question: When in a fight does the damage arrive?

values.burst_window: big damage in a short window, then waits on cooldowns
values.sustained_dps: steady damage as long as it stays alive and in range
values.chip_poke: small, repeated damage from range that wears targets down
values.execute_finisher: strongest on low health or marked targets
values.ramp_up: weak at first, scales through a fight or the game

damage_timing.draft_use: Burst beats healing and shields, chip is beaten by healing, so this pairs with the healer and tank lenses.

damage_reach.question: From how far can it deal its damage in a fight?

values.point_blank: must be on top of the target
values.short: short range, a few hero lengths
values.long: outranges most heroes and many abilities

damage_reach.draft_use: Range wars: who can hit whom without being hit, and what a melee front line can reach.

target_style.question: What does the damage hit?

values.percent_health: percent of max health damage that tanks feel
values.structure_focus: built to hit forts, towers and cores
values.minion_focus: wave clear first, hero damage second

target_style.draft_use: Percent damage and single target answer tanks, aoe answers clumped and squishy teams.

damage_reliability.question: What must go right for the damage to land?

values.guaranteed: point and click or auto attacks that always hit once in range
values.skillshot: must aim abilities, can be dodged
values.setup_needed: needs a partner CC, a stun or a stack first
values.stack_or_quest: depends on stacks or a quest that takes time or has to be protected
values.positioning: needs a flank, a safe angle or a specific stance

damage_reliability.draft_use: Skillshot damage is weak into mobile heroes, setup damage needs partners with CC.

frontline_style.question: What kind of front line is this hero (tanks and bruisers)?

values.initiator: starts fights with a big engage
values.anchor_peeler: holds position and protects the backline
values.disruptor: breaks up the enemy team, pulls or knocks back
values.brawler_sustain: wins long fights by outlasting, lifesteal or self heals
values.dive_bruiser: jumps on the backline and fights there
values.zone_controller: denies space with walls, fields and slows
values.not_frontline: does not take the front line

frontline_style.draft_use: A comp usually needs one hero that initiates and one that protects; two initiators with no peel is a coin flip.

durability_source.question: How does it stay alive?

values.relies_on_healer: needs a healer to stay in the fight

durability_source.draft_use: Heroes that rely on a healer bring more value into low pressure fights and less into dive.

lane_role.question: Where does it want to play before the fights?

values.solo_laner: can take a lane alone and hold or push it
values.split_pusher: wins by pushing a lane alone and pulling attention
values.rotator: moves between lanes and fights, does not hold a lane
values.soak_and_group: groups with the team and soaks with it
values.camp_taker: takes mercenary camps to speed rotations
values.no_lane: does not want a lane at all

lane_role.draft_use: A draft needs a lane plan: one solo laner and who rotates.

kill_pattern.question: How does it get kills?

values.backline_dive: jumps over the front line to the backline
values.flank_pick: comes from the side or behind to pick off a hero
values.stealth_ambush: stealth or untargetable setup then burst
values.burst_snipe: a long range burst on a target
values.cc_chain: catches with CC and others finish
values.attrition: wins by chip damage and positional squeezing

kill_pattern.draft_use: Pick comps want several different kill patterns; dive comps want the CC chain to hold the backline.

escape.question: Can it get out after it commits or is caught?

values.partial: one escape on a cooldown or conditional
values.none: no escape, a catch is a death

escape.draft_use: Heroes with no escape are the targets of dive and stun comps, and are kept alive by peel.

setup_reliance.question: Does it start things or finish things?

values.self_starter: can create its own kill opportunities
values.needs_cc_partner: needs another hero CC or engage to get value
values.needs_peel: needs to be protected to deal damage
values.cleanup: cleans up after a fight started by others

setup_reliance.draft_use: Counts of needs_cc_partner heroes must be matched by CC providers on the comp.

healer_class.question: What kind of healer or support is this?

values.burst_single: big heals on one target (Uther, Ana, Anduin)
values.sustain_single: steady healing on one or two targets (Malfurion, Deckard, Li Li)
values.aoe_sustain: heals many people through chip damage (Brightwing, Lucio, Stukov, Auriel)
values.hit_and_run: weak heals, strong mobility or utility
values.utility_support: buffs, speed, vision or macro tools more than healing

healer_class.draft_use: Match healers to comps: poke teams want sustain, dive teams want burst heals, a shield support makes a squishy comp playable.

healer_safety.question: How exposed is the healer?

values.safe: heals from range or has escapes
values.conditional: safe when positioned well or peeled
values.exposed: must be in danger to heal

healer_safety.draft_use: An exposed healer into dive is a trade you lose.

utility_tool.question: What non damage tool does it bring?

values.speed_buff: speed aura or buff to the team

utility_tool.draft_use: Utility explains why a hero is picked beyond damage and healing.

cc_profile.question: How much CC and what kind?

values.chain_hard: two or more reliable hard CC tools that chain
values.single_hard: one reliable hard CC (a stun or silence)
values.talent_dependent: CC only if a talent is taken

cc_profile.draft_use: Comps need several hard CC tools to hold targets for burst; too little means damage dealers cannot land setup combos.

cc_delivery.question: How hard is the CC to land?

values.skillshot: must be aimed, can be dodged

cc_delivery.draft_use: Skillshot CC into mobile heroes is unreliable; point and click chains beat mobile comps.

anti_cc.question: How does it deal with enemy CC?

values.shield_or_bubble: block or shield that protects it
values.mobility_through: dash or leap out of CC

anti_cc.draft_use: Heavy CC comps are blanked by cleanse and unstoppable tools, so a team needs at least one answer.

wave_clear_style.question: How does it clear lanes?

values.aoe_burst: one or two abilities clear a wave fast
values.summons_or_zone: pets, turrets or zones clear while it does other things

wave_clear_style.draft_use: Maps with waves and objectives need at least one burst or summon clearer; zero is a macro loss.

camp_play.question: Can it take mercenary camps well?

values.ok: can take camps with some time

camp_play.draft_use: Camp control sets the tempo for objective timings.

objective_role.question: What does it do at objectives?

values.zone_hold: holds ground at the objective with CC and zone
values.global_presence: impacts both objective and lanes from far away
values.siege_pressure: pressures forts and keeps the enemy honest between objectives

objective_role.draft_use: Different maps reward different objective roles.

split_potential.question: How well can it split push or draw attention in a lane?

values.strong: a one hero lane that must be answered
values.some: can split briefly or with a talent

split_potential.draft_use: A split comp needs one hero strong at it and the rest able to fight 4 on 5 or hold.

map_mobility.question: How fast can it move around the map and into a fight?
map_mobility.draft_use: Mobility decides who wins rotations; low mobility comps lose double objectives.

vision_stealth.question: What does it do for vision and information?

power_curve.question: When is it strongest?

values.early_dominant: early lane and early fight power, loses value late
values.late_scaler: weak early, dominates at level 16 to 20
values.stack_dependent: power depends on a quest or stacks

power_curve.draft_use: Early comps want fights before level 10, late scalers want long games; a draft with both is confused.

snowball.question: How does it react to leads and deficits?

values.snowballer: gets much stronger from kills or leads
values.comeback: has a way to come back (global ult, long range siege, mobility)

snowball.draft_use: Snowball comps punish slow starts; comeback tools are insurance.

ultimate_role.question: What is its heroic or ultimate for?

values.teamfight_swing: swings a fight when it lands
values.low_impact: weak heroic, the hero is picked for its basic kit

ultimate_role.draft_use: A comp needs a fight swinger, and the opposing comp ults should be answered.

execution_demand.question: How hard is it to play well?
execution_demand.draft_use: A comfort pick for the player usually beats a theoretically better pick that is hard.

team_needs.question: What does it need from the team to function?

values.front_line: a front line to stand behind
values.wave_clear: someone else clears waves while it fights

team_needs.draft_use: Counting needs across the five heroes shows whether the comp ask exceeds what it provides.

team_gives.question: What does it give its teammates?
team_gives.draft_use: The comp checker adds gives against needs.

vulnerable_to.question: What does it lose to?

values.dive: enemy dives and assassins reaching it
values.hard_cc: stuns, roots and silences while exposed
values.sustain_heals: enemy healing that blunts its damage
values.stealth: stealth and ambush it cannot see
values.focus_fire: being focused by the whole team
values.kiting: being kited by mobile ranged heroes
values.zoning: being walled out of the fight
values.macro_split: enemy split pushing while it fights
values.early_pressure: being pressured early before it scales

vulnerable_to.draft_use: Turns into a weakness map: add up what the comp is vulnerable to against what the enemy brings.

comp_affinity.question: Which comp archetypes does it fit?

values.poke_siege: long range chip damage and siege
values.dive_burst: jump on the backline and burst
values.sustain_teamfight: long fights with healing and shields
values.pick_catch: catch and kill targets before the fight

comp_affinity.draft_use: The archetype tally of the five picks tells you what the comp is trying to do and what it forgot.
